genuine.subject: DLD rent increase question
genuine.body:
Hello DLD,

My landlord has told me he will raise my rent by 15% when my contract renews on 1 March. I pay AED 80,000 a year for a one-bedroom apartment. I checked the DLD Rental Index calculator and the average for similar units is AED 100,000. He told me about the increase by WhatsApp last week. Is this increase allowed, and what can I do?

Thank you,
Mariam
